mechanism_of_action: Potent inhibitor of the ileal bile acid transporter (iBAT).
primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in serum LDL-C at Week 16.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 16, LDL-C changed by −0.57 mmol/L with elobixibat vs −0.17 mmol/L with placebo (p=0.029).
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/23 with elobixibat and 0/24 with placebo; no deaths in either group.
